content.rendered:
Bond Owner’s Representative, Rick Rainone of Cornerstone Management Group, Inc., presented to the Sherwood School District Board members, on June 14, 2017, a list of projects that are scheduled to be completed in the summer of 2018 using bond funds.

Status on the progress of the projects will continue to be shared with the Board, as well as updates in the District Newsletter and on this web site as news becomes available

Overview

The Bond Management Team approved the following projects for construction in the summer of 2018.  The projects were selected based on urgent needs, safety and security, and other repair and replacement needs.

Scope

  • Deferred Maintenance: Seismic
  • Improvements, Flooring, Wire Glass
  • Replacement, Plumbing, HVAC
  • Electrical, Food Service, Interior and Exterior Paint and General Site Improvements

Schools

  • Sherwood HS
  • Sherwood MS
  • Middleton ES
  • Hopkins ES

Scope

  • DAS/Cell Boost (Phase 1)

Schools

  • Sherwood MS
  • Laurel Ridge MS
